# ESP Web Tools dependency notices

Original notices copied from integrity-verified npm tarballs at the versions in upstream commit `fab2ba48253d19fd29a15af57bec771d34978b62`.

See `DEPENDENCIES.json` for original archive URLs, npm integrity values, archive SHA-256 values and each retained notice hash. This conservatively includes all production dependencies, including type-only or tree-shaken entries; it is not a claim that every package occurs in the emitted browser bundle. Build-tool development packages are not distributed.

The ssr-dom-shim npm package omitted its full license text. Its original source copyright header is retained here with the root BSD-3-Clause license from the npm-published git revision, linked in the manifest.

The upstream web bundle remains byte-for-byte unchanged, including its embedded license comments and serial-loader stubs.
